versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.0 is a major release with expanded features and detailed usage prompts.

- Added comprehensive, platform-specific content generation prompts (Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook)
- Introduced in-depth hashtag research and strategy frameworks with generation methods and best practices per platform
- Enhanced content calendar templates with daily/weekly/monthly planning and optimal posting time guidelines
- Expanded engagement analysis, listing key metrics for each social platform
- Included prompts and templates for campaign coordination, content repurposing, and multi-platform optimization
